verdict.rationale: Insomnia lets users choose storage mode—Local Vault, Cloud Sync, or Git Sync to a self-hosted/3rd-party repo—giving some control over where data physically resides, and Kong states its cloud servers cannot read synced project data. However there is no evidence of selectable geographic region/data-residency options within Insomnia's cloud offering itself. Missing for 10: explicit region selection for cloud-hosted data, documented data-residency/compliance zones, independent confirmation of storage location guarantees.
